objects.name: a writing desk with a locked drawer

secret.description: Wilhelm Hochstetter is alone with Salvatore Alfano in the Roof Garden from 7:30 PM, and kills Salvatore Alfano at 7:30 PM.

people.name: Lyman Ellery
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Lyman Ellery is with Maureen Callahan in the Service Stairs from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Louis Hurwitz drinks alone in the Bar from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

people.name: Maureen Callahan
people.role: a bookmaker in a small way

secret.description: Maureen Callahan is with Lyman Ellery in the Service Stairs from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

secret.description: Bernard Feldman slips out to the Street from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.
Gretchen Steinbach meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 6:00 PM to 6:30 PM and asks for money.

method.name: a push from the roof garden
method.bodyEvidence: Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.

environment.radioContent: a dance band from the Roseland
environment.radioOutcome: the band broke off twice and the announcer filled with a soap advertisement

Salvatore Alfano was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 7:00 PM and 7:30 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 10:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Wilhelm Hochstetter's sleeve; Wilhelm Hochstetter was on the stairs at 11:00 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Gretchen Steinbach's sleeve; Gretchen Steinbach was on the stairs at 11:00 PM.

Domenica Lanza says the bar radio carried a dance band from the Roseland at 10:30 PM, and that the band broke off twice and the announcer filled with a soap advertisement. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A draft codicil in Salvatore Alfano's hand striking Wilhelm Hochstetter out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Domenica Lanza says Salvatore Alfano told Wilhelm Hochstetter the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Maureen Callahan's name, waiting only on Salvatore Alfano's signature.
Lyman Ellery says Salvatore Alfano told Maureen Callahan the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
